introHtml: Folding buttons, stickers, and patches add an interactive twist to standard promotional merchandise. Unlike flat lapel pins or static decals, these items feature a hinge or fold mechanism that lets them convert from a compact shape into a larger display piece. Marketing directors use them at trade shows to hand out memorable giveaways that stand out in a swag bag. HR directors and safety managers appreciate the compact storage and the ability to include extra information inside the fold. Choose from standard shapes or custom die-cut designs with full-color imprinting.
